text: **Hint 1:** For each candidate value of the regularizer parameter $\lambda$, Jessica will perform cross-validation. Consider how many folds are used in the cross-validation process.\n\n**Hint 2:** Remember that in k-fold cross-validation, the data is split into k subsets, and the model is trained and validated k times, each time using a different subset as the validation set and the remaining subsets as the training set.
